description: Ministry of Higher Educaction & Highways - Order made to appoint Prof. Jayantha Walihinda to be the Competent Authority of Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute w.e.f. 27.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette content involves the appointment of a Competent Authority (Professor Jayantha Walihinda) to exercise powers in lieu of the Director of an educational institute due to administrative failure. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it represents an administrative intervention through legal authority (Universities Act) to address institutional governance issues, making it a Type 9 classification rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
